item.title: Lume 0.4.0
item.description:
What's new in 0.4.0 beta

Automatic updates

  • Lume now updates itself. It checks once a day and lets you know when a new version is ready, or choose Lume → Check for Updates… any time.
  • Turn automatic checks or background installs on or off in Settings → General → Updates.
  • Updates are signed, and Lume only installs ones signed by us.

A cleaner new tab

  • New tabs now open to a calm, empty page in your space's colours. Press ⌘T or ⌘L to search or go somewhere.
  • Prefer the old start page with a greeting, favourites and recently visited sites? Turn on Show start page in new tabs in Settings → General or during setup.

Sidebar

  • Clear: hover over your tabs and click ↓ Clear to close every tab that isn't pinned or in a folder. Changed your mind? ⇧⌘T brings them back.
  • Pinned tabs and pinned extensions now stretch to fill the sidebar when you only have a few.

Zoom

  • Pinch to zoom on a trackpad now works on web pages.
  • When a site is zoomed with ⌘+ or ⌘−, the address bar shows the zoom level (like 110%). Click it to go back to 100%.

Install

  • Download Lume.dmg below, open it and drag Lume.app into Applications.
  • Lume isn't notarized by Apple, so macOS blocks it the first time you open it. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security, scroll down and click Open Anyway next to the message about Lume, then confirm. You only need to do this once.

Already on 0.3.0? Install 0.4.0 by hand this one time. From 0.4.0 on, Lume updates itself.

Requirements

  • macOS 15.4 or later.
